messages.content:
To see the contestants’ info (number + name), query the `CONTESTANTS` table:

```sql
SELECT
  contestant_number,
  contestant_name
FROM CONTESTANTS
ORDER BY contestant_number;
```

Do you want just the list, or also vote totals per contestant (overall or by state)?
focus on contestants who got at least two votes

```sql
SELECT
  c.contestant_number,
  c.contestant_name,
  COUNT(v.vote_id) AS vote_count
FROM CONTESTANTS c
JOIN VOTES v
  ON v.contestant_number = c.contestant_number
GROUP BY
  c.contestant_number,
  c.contestant_name
HAVING COUNT(v.vote_id) >= 2
ORDER BY vote_count DESC, c.contestant_number;
```
don't forget, I need to know their contestant number too

```sql

  c.contestant_number,
  c.contestant_name,
  COUNT(v.vote_id) AS vote_count

GROUP BY
  c.contestant_number,
  c.contestant_name
HAVING COUNT(v.vote_id) >= 2
ORDER BY vote_count DESC, c.contestant_number;
```
